svg.title: Lesson 51 lab walkthrough
svg.desc: Run the complete suite, inspect sixteen passing rows, run a single-failure mutation, restore the suite and replay six fixtures. Only the normal complete suite earns credit.

g.text: 1 Run All 16, mutation off → 16/16 and zero calls
2 Inspect ordered rows, scoped lookup, terminal and cleanup
4 Restore normal suite; replay six synthetic fixtures
Filtered groups and replay are observations; complete normal 16/16 earns credit.
